text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having concluded her challenge for the 
Triple Tiara, Mejiro Dober set her next 
target on the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Mejiro Dober, both the distance and 
the stacked competition will surely make 
this a harsh battle. However, it will 
serve as fuel for her next challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Far from being intimidated, Mejiro Dober 
is overjoyed to run alongside the 
upperclassman she admires, Air Groove, 
openly displaying her motivation for the 
real race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Mejiro Dober was surprised to learn 
she had placed 3rd in the preliminary 
popularity poll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving blessings from the Umamusume of 
the Mejiro family, she inwardly vowed to 
run a race worthy of being hailed as "the 
new glory of the Mejiros."
